description: Ready-to-paste citation for one book: title, author, canonical page URL, Markdown URL, license and the public-domain territory notice. When to use: before quoting or summarising a book, so the answer carries a verifiable source. Do not use: to fetch content (use cyberlibrary_get_chapter). Returns: {title, author, page_url, markdown_url, license, source_url, citation, notice}.
name: cyberlibrary_cite
